description: Fallow quality baseline. Counters may shrink but not grow; averageMaintainability may rise but not drop. Regenerate with `npm run check:quality -- --update` (commit the diff in the same PR that moves the metric). criticalComplexity is CRAP-based: measure with no coverage/ or coverage-vue/ artifacts present (as CI's quality job does) or it inflates. 2026-07-18 (PR #494 marketplace review round 9): averageMaintainability 90.1->90.2 — extracting assertInstallableAgentBody out of installAgent (agent-body validation) kept complexFunctions at 243 and lifted the whole-project average.
